data.body: **[P2] Keep errorless invoke hooks consistent across live and replay paths.** This converter now makes an empty `ChainedInvokeDetails.Error` produce `error: undefined`, but the live failure branch in `invoke-handler.ts` still unconditionally overwrites it with `new Error("Invoke failed")`. The same backend failure therefore exports an exception if the handler reaches the invoke promise, but no exception when replayed or flushed from `onOperationChange`. Preserve `operationInfo.error` instead of synthesizing an error when details are absent, and add live, replay, and deferred empty-error invoke tests.
